points.label: Response and forgiveness
points.left: Joseph weeps, refuses God’s place, distinguishes intentions, promises provision, comforts them without an explicit “I forgive you” formula.
points.right: again refuses release when his heart is hardened.

payload.posture: Both scenes begin with a request, but one response comforts without a pardon formula and the other is followed by renewed refusal.

rightEvidence.title: Pharaoh asks forgiveness and returns to refusal

payload.tension: Joseph’s brothers request forgiveness for their evil, while Joseph weeps, refuses God’s place, distinguishes intentions, promises provision, and comforts them without an explicit “I forgive you” formula. Pharaoh confesses, asks forgiveness and prayer, receives relief, and again refuses release when his heart is hardened.
